topic.title: Independent Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: Independent Review Tasks let Subject-Matter Experts create, manage, and review content outside the Content Fusion project workflow.

body.p: An Independent Review Task is a review task that is not associated with a Content Fusion project. It can be created in the Content Fusion interface or from Oxygen XML Author or Oxygen XML Editor.

This workflow is useful for quick reviews, ad hoc collaboration, or cases where the content is prepared specifically for review. Any follow-up integration into the source content is handled outside the Content Fusion project workflow.

section.title: When to use Independent Review Tasks

ul.li: When you need a simple review workflow for a small set of files.
When you want to start and manage the review yourself.
When the content is not part of a Content Fusion project.
When the source content comes from Oxygen XML Author or Oxygen XML Editor.

section.title: What Subject-Matter Experts do in these tasks
section.p: Subject-Matter Experts work with Independent Review Tasks in much the same way as any other review task. They can participate as reviewers by opening a shared task, reading the content, adding comments, suggesting changes, and replying to discussions. They can also create and manage these tasks as task owners.

section.title: How this differs from a Project Review Task
section.p: A Project Review Task is created from content in a Content Fusion project and includes an integration step that brings accepted changes back into the project content. An Independent Review Task is not tied to a Content Fusion project. If the task was created from Oxygen XML Author or Oxygen XML Editor, the follow-up integration is handled in the desktop application.
